name: ai-invest-research-copilot
description: Investment-research AI advisor that maps tasks — financials lookup, thesis curation, strategy backtesting, factor research, quant systems knowledge — to five open-source projects, then checks deployment and model requirements before you commit.

displayDescription.en: Maps research tasks — financials, thesis curation, backtesting, factor research — to five open-source projects, checks deployment and model needs, then holds the compliance and human-confirmation line.
displayDescription.zh: 把查财报、理投资逻辑、跑策略回测这些活交给 AI，从五个开源项目挑能落地的一套并核对。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想把投研里的查财报、理逻辑、跑回测交给 AI，该用哪套开源项目？
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to hand off research tasks — financials, thesis curation, backtesting — to AI. Which open-source stack fits?
